comment: No source is published; the maker's manual is at factionoptions.com/manual. The module declares no parameters, inputs or outputs, so nothing here can be tagged; every setting is on the right-click menu, named here exactly as the module prints it. The universe is clamped for the chosen transport at load time, which is what the 'DmxHub: clamped universe to %u' warning reports. The four address choices are the maker's own and the numbers in them are addresses rather than measurements.
